title: Output of SEC Form D Funding Signals
description: One row per matched Form D filing in the default dataset, plus a RUN_SUMMARY record in the default key-value store.

filings.title: Funding filings
filings.description: Newly funded companies from SEC Form D (dataset view 'filings').

signals.title: Scored signals and changes
signals.description: Signal score, reasons and new/changed issuer labels (dataset view 'signals'; filled when Signal score or Change tracking is on).

runSummary.title: Run summary
runSummary.description: Counts of index rows, filings fetched, matched and pushed.
